_: Real mainnet-beta v0 transactions that use address lookup tables, and the lookup-table accounts they reference, captured read-only. Mutations are the same transactions re-serialized with exactly one field changed; the round-trip was asserted byte-identical before mutating, so nothing here is hand-assembled. Signatures are not re-signed and are not valid for the mutated bytes: Graphite is a pre-signature gate and never verifies them.

mutations.name: privilege_moved_writable_to_readonly
mutations.what_changed: the first writable index was moved into the readonly list; the same account is still reached
mutations.expected: the resolved account set is unchanged but the writable/readonly split differs from the genuine transaction

mutations.name: writable_index_substituted
mutations.what_changed: writable index 45 -> 1, both real entries of the same real table
mutations.expected: resolves to Cwv76aL4S3xcfTfbZX3UbV1Xmrjdk2v7XWtv5crCpump instead of BWXT6RUhit9FfJQM3pBmqeFLPYmuxgmyhMGC5sGr8RbA; identical counts

mutations.name: table_substituted
mutations.what_changed: the lookup table address FaronxfQywWwUoDycQ4Jb9bS1UNu1RhiXP4jTQuBHhPp -> 24MSaP3phDW5gGiCP78SM5n9i8cvKYTotXBqCm7ZGuYb, both real mainnet tables
mutations.expected: every resolved account changes while the table count, index count and index values are identical

mutations.name: index_past_end_of_table
mutations.what_changed: a writable index of 255 against a table holding 254 addresses
mutations.expected: resolution must refuse entirely rather than resolve the other indexes
